text: The dimension of the space $\mathrm{Cl}(G)$ of complex class functions on $G$ equals:
choices: the number of conjugacy classes of $G$
the number of irreducible characters, which exceeds the number of conjugacy classes
explanation: A class function is constant on conjugacy classes, so the indicator functions of the classes form a basis and $\dim\mathrm{Cl}(G)$ is the number of conjugacy classes. Using $|G|$ overcounts (that is $\dim\mathbb{C}[G]$); the number of irreducible characters equals -- rather than exceeds -- the number of classes; and $\sum_i(\dim V_i)^2=|G|$.
